generated_for: Solotech - touring media-server / LED processing package (Doja Cat lineage)

conventions.label: Devices are labelled Name over Make_Model, matching the GX3 as-built drawing.
conventions.socket_naming: Socket names follow the as-built exactly where the as-built covers the device (e.g. '12G-SDI_IN A', '12G-SDI_OUT 1', 'HDMI_2.0 1', 'LAN A', 'MGMT', 'REF_IN', 'PWR_IN'). Devices not in the as-built follow the same grammar.

signals_added_here.SMF: Single-mode fibre. The as-built legend only has MMF; the 1310nm links in this rig are single-mode.
signals_added_here.DANTE: Dante/AES67 audio network. Distinct from LAN so the audio network is traceable.

conventions.connectors: BNC, MICROBNC, HDMI, HDMI-C, DP, DVI, RJ45, EC5e, EC6A, LCDUP, LC, OpticalCON DUO, XLR3F, XLR3M, XLR5F, XLR5M, DB25, HD15, TRS, DIN5, TOSLINK, RCA, USB-A, USB-B, IEC, NAC3FX-W-TOP, NAC3MX-W-TOP, 4PIN-DC, DC. EC5e/EC6A and LCDUP are taken verbatim from the as-built legend.

confidence.verified: The socket exists and is named/typed from a manufacturer datasheet/manual or from the client's own as-built drawing. A per-socket note flags any part of the entry (usually the connector type) that is still an inference.
confidence.inferred: The socket almost certainly exists but the source does not state it explicitly; reasoning is in the note.
confidence.assumed: Placeholder. Do not cable against it without confirming.

conventions.hard_rule: No port in this file was invented to round out a device. Where a device is incomplete it is marked so rather than filled in.
